finalText:
Found it. The engine was rounding after each coupon instead of rounding once at the end.

When you stack coupons, the code applied the percent discount and rounded to 2 decimals, then applied the flat discount and rounded again, then converted currency and rounded a third time. Each intermediate rounding introduced small errors that compounded into the cent-or-two mismatches you saw.

The fix was to remove those intermediate rounds in `engine.js:24` and `engine.js:27`. Now the calculation keeps full precision all the way through, then rounds exactly once at the very end after currency conversion—matching the test's reference implementation. All 40 tests pass.
